=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:718, 866-890 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_check_credentials` returns "met" for a credentials step when any workflow in `OBSERVABLE_CREDENTIAL_WORKFLOWS` has a recent successful run, so a successful `security-audit.yml` run counts as proof for `GH_PAT`, even though that workflow declares `GH_PAT: required: false` and falls back to `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` (security-audit.yml line 503).
  WHY: When `GH_PAT` is unset and only `security-audit.yml` has succeeded in the last 7 days, an "Add GH_PAT" step is ticked silently and `_close_tracker_when_done` can close the tracker as completed with the secret still missing. All flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR. minimax raised it twice, once under correctness and once under trust boundary, with the same root cause, so the two are merged here. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to call it a defect, because plan line 344 explicitly accepts a `security-audit.yml` run as proof, and listed it only as optional hardening.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:741, 752-758, 800-804, 823-826 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `CREDENTIAL_REPO_FLAG_RE` and `CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE` require whitespace or `=` after `--repo`/`-R`, so the attached short form `gh secret set GH_PAT -Racme/other` is not counted as a flag. The flag-count check then passes vacuously and the cross-repository check is skipped.
  WHY: A credential step that targets another repository is classified as `credentials` and can be ticked using this repository's own successful run. Severities disagree: gemini rated it MAJOR and glm rated it NIT, so the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna raised the same issue only as a hardening suggestion.

(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/operator_step_issue.py:`CREDENTIAL_REPO_FLAG_RE` / `_observable_condition`
  PROBLEM: The attached form `gh secret set GH_PAT -Racme/other` is not counted as a flag, so the step is classified as `credentials` and could be ticked using this repository's own run.
  WHY: This is the one remaining way past the repository check. Suggested fix: return None when `re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])-R[^\s=]", text)` matches (2-3 lines).
- HARDENING (optional, plan allows it): scripts/operator_step_issue.py:`OBSERVABLE_CREDENTIAL_WORKFLOWS` / `_check_credentials`
  PROBLEM: `security-audit.yml` runs without `GH_PAT` because it falls back to `github.token` (`.github/workflows/security-audit.yml` line 503), so its success does not show that `GH_PAT` is set.
  WHY: Plan line 344 accepts this proof today. Suggested fix, only if the plan owner agrees: accept a `security-audit.yml` run as proof only for an `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` step (4-6 lines).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:718, 871-889 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_check_credentials` treats a successful run of `security-audit.yml` as proof for `GH_PAT` or `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
  WHY: `security-audit.yml` uses `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` and does not require either secret, so the operator step can be ticked wrongly and the tracker closed without the secrets being configured.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:741, 755-758, 800-804 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `CREDENTIAL_REPO_FLAG_RE` does not match attached short-form flags such as `-Racme/other`.
  WHY: The regex requires a space or `=`, so the flag-versus-slug count comparison fails to recognise the step, which can then be ticked wrongly or classified wrongly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:line 718 (OBSERVABLE_CREDENTIAL_WORKFLOWS = ("review_autofix.yml", "internal-review.yml", "security-audit.yml")) and lines 866-890 (_check_credentials) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_check_credentials` returns "met" as soon as any listed workflow has a recent successful run. `security-audit.yml` has `GH_PAT` `required: false` (.github/workflows/security-audit.yml:58-67) and falls back to `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` (line 503), so a "Add the GH_PAT secret" step is ticked and `_close_tracker_when_done` can close the tracker with `state_reason=completed`.
  WHY: Only review_autofix.yml and internal-review.yml require `GH_PAT`. The check is correct for `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (security-audit.yml line 61, `required: true`), and the failure path is silent.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:line 718 and the loop at lines 871-886 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM (trust boundary): `OBSERVABLE_CREDENTIAL_WORKFLOWS` lets a workflow that does not need the secret stand in as proof, so a missing `GH_PAT` is hidden behind a successful `security-audit.yml` run.
  WHY: Same root cause as the correctness finding above: the operator-step tracker is closed silently.
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/operator_step_issue.py:CREDENTIAL_REPO_FLAG_RE (line 758) and CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE (line 752)
  PROBLEM: The attached form `gh secret set GH_PAT -Racme/other` is not counted as a flag, so the step is classified as `credentials`.
  WHY: Suggested fix: also match `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])(?:--repo|-R)(?=\S)`, or fail closed when the flag count exceeds the slug count (3-5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:OBSERVABLE_CREDENTIAL_WORKFLOWS (line 718) and _check_credentials (lines 866-890) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The credential proof is not credential-specific. `security-audit.yml` declares `GH_PAT: required: false` (security-audit.yml lines 58-60) and uses `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` (security-audit.yml line 503), yet `_check_credentials` returns "met" for an "Add GH_PAT" step on that run alone (lines 885-886).
  WHY: In a quiet repository, `_close_tracker_when_done` closes the tracker as completed with `GH_PAT` never configured, which contradicts the module docstring (scripts/operator_step_issue.py:85-87). Suggested fix: map each credential to the workflows that require it (review_autofix.yml lines 86-89).
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:CREDENTIAL_REPO_FLAG_RE (line 758) and CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE (lines 752-755), checked in _observable_condition (lines 823-826) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The attached form `gh secret set GH_PAT -Racme/other` matches neither pattern, so the flag-count invariant passes vacuously and the repository check is skipped.
  WHY: A step targeting another repository can be ticked from this repository's own run. Suggested fix: extend the `-R` alternative, or return None on `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])-R[^\s=]` (2-3 lines).
- HARDENING: the two hardening suggestions repeat the findings above: a credential-to-workflow mapping in `_check_credentials` (3-6 lines) and catching the attached `-R` value (2-3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5 (2 related items)
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
